title: Taiwanese Student Association at UIUC
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association at UIUC (UIUC TSA) is a registered student organization at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. It is also registered through the university’s official club platform at one.illinois.edu. The organization’s Chinese name, 台灣學生會, appears on its Instagram profile. Its stated purpose is to serve and connect the Taiwanese community in the Champaign-Urbana region, with particular focus on Taiwanese students and faculty at UIUC.

TSA frames its work around two pillars — service and culture. On the service side, the organization describes its activities as voluntary deeds that give back to the Taiwanese community in Champaign-Urbana. On the cultural side, it promotes awareness of Taiwan through events and cultural programming. Recurring annual events listed on the organization’s website include a Kick-off Party, Mid-Autumn Festival BBQ, Night Market, New Year Banquet, and New Students Orientation. Fall programming emphasizes social and networking opportunities, while spring programming focuses on informational topics such as career development, taxation, and immigration status.

TSA envisions itself, in its own words, as “a friendly and practical media for Taiwaneses to recognize and/or help each other.” The organization maintains an active Instagram presence under the handle @tsa_uiuc, a Facebook page, a Linktree, and a dedicated website at uiuctsa.com.
